exercises.title: Name a summary query: note_summary
exercises.problemHtml:
Create the view note_summary (user_id, email, notes, tong_views): one row per user with the number of notes and the total views. Then the dashboard can just say SELECT * FROM note_summary ORDER BY tong_views DESC LIMIT 3.

Sample tables (chapter 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Requirements

  • CREATE VIEW note_summary AS SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.email, count(n.id) AS notes, COALESCE(sum(n.views), 0) AS tong_views ….
  • Users without notes still appear (LEFT JOIN).

Tạo view note_summary (user_id, email, notes, tong_views): mỗi user một dòng với số ghi chú và tổng views. Khi đó dashboard chỉ cần SELECT * FROM note_summary ORDER BY tong_views DESC LIMIT 3.

Bảng mẫu (chương 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE VIEW note_summary AS SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.email, count(n.id) AS notes, COALESCE(sum(n.views), 0) AS tong_views ….
  • User chưa có ghi chú vẫn xuất hiện (LEFT JOIN).

starterCodeJson.name: notes12.sql

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
CREATE VIEW note_summary AS
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.email,
       count(n.id)               AS notes,
       COALESCE(sum(n.views), 0) AS tong_views
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN notes n ON n.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.email;

solutionCodeJson.name: notes12.sql

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A view gives a query a name and a stable interface: callers do not repeat the join and the grouping, and you can change the inside later. It stores no data, so it is always current.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: View đặt tên cho truy vấn và cho một giao diện ổn định: người gọi không phải lặp lại phép nối và gom nhóm, và bạn đổi được phần bên trong sau này. Nó không lưu dữ liệu nên luôn mới.

exercises.title: A writable view that cannot leak rows: WITH CHECK OPTION
exercises.problemHtml:
User 1's screen works through the view note_cua_user1 = the notes of user 1. Make it writable for that screen, but so that an UPDATE or INSERT through the view can never create a row that the view would not show (for example moving a note to user 2).

Sample tables (chapter 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Requirements

  • CREATE VIEW note_cua_user1 AS SELECT id, user_id, title, views FROM notes WHERE user_id = 1 WITH CHECK OPTION.
  • A simple single-table view is automatically updatable.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Màn hình của user 1 làm việc qua view note_cua_user1 = các ghi chú của user 1. Cho nó ghi được với màn hình đó, nhưng sao cho UPDATE hay INSERT qua view không bao giờ tạo ra dòng mà view không hiện (vd chuyển ghi chú sang user 2).

Bảng mẫu (chương 12)

users (id identity PK, email UNIQUE)                         20 rows user1@notes.vn … user20@notes.vn
notes (id identity PK, user_id → users, title, body, views int DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)
      500 rows, 25 per user; views = (id * 37) % 101 (0 … 100); created_at = updated_at = 2020-01-01 08:00

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE VIEW note_cua_user1 AS SELECT id, user_id, title, views FROM notes WHERE user_id = 1 WITH CHECK OPTION.
  • View đơn giản trên một bảng tự động cập nhật được.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Single-table views without aggregates are automatically updatable. WITH CHECK OPTION adds a guard: every row written through the view must satisfy its WHERE, otherwise SQLSTATE 44000.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: View một bảng không có tổng hợp tự động cập nhật được. WITH CHECK OPTION thêm chốt chặn: mọi dòng ghi qua view phải thoả WHERE của nó, nếu không là SQLSTATE 44000.

exercises.title: The order list the API needs, as a view
exercises.problemHtml:
The mobile API shows orders without ever exposing the phone number or e-mail of customers. Create v_order_summary (order_id, customer_name, city, status, created_at, items, total, paid): items = Σ qty, total = Σ qty × unit_price, paid = whether a payment exists. Then use it: return the paid orders of Hà Nội customers, newest first — order_id, customer_name, total.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • Aggregate order_item per order inside the view; LEFT JOIN payment for the paid flag.
  • The last statement is the SELECT on the view.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE VIEW v_order_summary AS
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.full_name AS customer_name, c.city, o.status, o.created_at,
       i.items, i.total,
       p.id IS NOT NULL AS paid
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(qty) AS items, sum(qty * unit_price) AS total
      FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id) i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id;      -- no phone, no email: the API cannot leak what the view does not have

SELECT order_id, customer_name, total
FROM v_order_summary
WHERE paid AND city = 'Hà Nội'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

Three facts about views.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# What a view is — and is not — answer key

1. Is a plain view faster than running its SELECT directly?View thường có nhanh hơn chạy trực tiếp câu SELECT của nó không?
   Answer: c) no: the view is expanded into the query
   A view is rewritten into the calling query (rewriter stage, lesson 1.4). Need stored results? That is a materialized view.VI: View được viết lại vào truy vấn gọi nó (bước rewriter, bài 1.4). Cần lưu kết quả? Đó là materialized view.

2. A view selects SELECT * FROM notes. Later a column is added to notes. Does the view show it?View chọn SELECT * FROM notes. Sau đó bảng notes thêm một cột. View có hiện cột đó không?
   Answer: d) no: * became a fixed column list at creation
   PostgreSQL stores the expanded column list. Recreate the view (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW) to pick up new columns.VI: PostgreSQL lưu danh sách cột đã bung. Tạo lại view (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW) để nhận cột mới.

3. Which view is automatically updatable?View nào tự động cập nhật được?
   Answer: c) SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE user_id = 1
   One base table, no aggregates/DISTINCT/GROUP BY, columns referenced directly ⇒ updatable. Others need INSTEAD OF triggers.VI: Một bảng gốc, không tổng hợp/DISTINCT/GROUP BY, cột tham chiếu trực tiếp ⇒ cập nhật được. Còn lại cần trigger INSTEAD OF.
